identity.google_sub: Use your Google account instead of typing your password.
identity.google_linked_text: You can sign in with this Google account or with your e-mail and password. Unlinking does not change your password.
identity.google_link_text: Link your Google account to sign in with one click on the {brand} sign-in page and on your clinic's staff sign-in page.
identity.google_confirm_help: For your security, then you will choose your Google account.
identity.google_unlink_confirm: Unlink this Google account? You will sign in with your e-mail and password only.
identity.admin_google_sub: Let clinic staff sign in with their Google account. Only existing {brand} accounts can sign in this way.
identity.admin_google_client_sub: From Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Credentials.
identity.secret_saved: A secret is saved ({hint}). Leave empty to keep it.
identity.secret_help: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again after saving.
identity.google_enable: Show "Continue with Google" on the sign-in pages
identity.google_rules: An account is found by its linked Google account or by its verified e-mail address. Unknown addresses are refused — new staff still join through an invitation. Platform admin accounts always sign in with their password.
identity.google_step2: Configure the OAuth consent screen (External, app name {brand}, your support e-mail) with the scopes openid, email and profile.
identity.google_step3: Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application. Authorized JavaScript origin:
identity.google_step5: Paste the Client ID and Client secret here, tick the switch and save.
identity.google_domains_note: Google sign-in always runs on the main {brand} address. Clinic custom domains send staff to the main address to sign in.
identity.domain_sub: Show your clinic page and online booking at your own address, e.g. book.yourclinic.com.
identity.domain_host_help: A subdomain such as book.yourclinic.com is easiest. You need access to the domain's DNS settings.
identity.domain_saved: Domain saved. Add the DNS records below, then verify.
identity.domain_pending_text: Add these two records at the company where the domain is registered (its DNS settings), then press Verify.
identity.domain_dns_wait: DNS changes usually appear within minutes but can take up to 48 hours. You can verify as often as you like.
identity.domain_remove_confirm: Remove {host}? Your clinic page will stop opening at this address.
identity.domain_still_live: The domain is live and its records are correct.
identity.domain_keep_txt: The ownership TXT record was not found on the last check. Keep it in your DNS settings.
identity.domain_missing_txt: The TXT record was not found yet. Check its name and value, or wait a little and verify again.
identity.domain_missing_cname: Ownership is confirmed, but the domain does not point to {brand} yet. Add the CNAME record and verify again.
identity.domain_live_text: Your clinic page and online booking open at {host}. Staff still sign in on the main {brand} address.
identity.domain_suspended_text: The {brand} team stopped this domain. Contact support to turn it back on.
identity.admin_domains_sub: Domains that clinics connected to their clinic page. A domain goes live after its DNS proves ownership and points to {brand}.
identity.admin_domains_empty_text: Clinics connect a domain in Settings → Clinic page.
identity.admin_clinic_suspended: Clinic suspended — the domain does not serve.
identity.admin_approve_confirm: Turn {host} on without the pointing check? Ownership is already proven by the TXT record.
identity.admin_suspend_confirm: Stop {host}? It stops serving the clinic page at once.
identity.admin_domain_resumed: Domain resumed. It goes live again once DNS is verified.
identity.admin_how1: The clinic adds a TXT record _docbook.<domain> with its token (ownership).
identity.admin_how2: The clinic adds a CNAME from its domain to {host} (or A records to this server for a bare domain).
identity.admin_how3: Your web server or proxy must accept the domain and have an HTTPS certificate for it (for example on-demand TLS or adding it as an alias domain).
identity.admin_how4: Only exact verified domains are served; any other host name falls back to the main site.
identity.admin_server_ip_hint: Set SERVER_IP in the environment so clinics with a bare domain (no subdomain) see which A record to add.
identity.google_link_ready: Password confirmed. Continue to Google and choose the account to link (within 5 minutes).

errors_identity.GOOGLE_OFF: Google sign-in is not available right now.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_STATE: This sign-in link has expired or was opened in another browser. Please start again.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_FAILED: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_TOKEN: Google's answer could not be verified. Please try again.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_NO_EMAIL: Your Google account did not share a verified e-mail address.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_NO_ACCOUNT: No {brand} account uses this Google e-mail. Ask your clinic for an invitation, or sign in with your password and link Google in Settings → Security.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_OTHER: This {brand} account is linked to a different Google account.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_NOT_ALLOWED: Platform admin accounts sign in with their password only.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_TAKEN: This Google account is already linked to another {brand} account.
errors_identity.GOOGLE_HOST: Open {brand} at its main address to link Google.
errors_identity.DOMAIN_SUSPENDED: The {brand} team stopped this domain. Contact support.
errors_identity.DOMAIN_NOT_OWNED: The ownership TXT record has not been found yet. Check the domain first.
errors_identity.DOMAIN_TAKEN: This domain is already connected to another clinic.
errors_identity.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors_identity.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors_identity.SECRETS_KEY: Set APP_KEY (or SESSION_SECRET) in the server environment before saving credentials.
